text.tspan: living design sketch · updated as decisions land · 2026-08-02
1. The four altitudes — where work lives
release (MVP → v1 → v1.2) is not a fifth rung — it is the time axis,
and each release cuts through all four
the entire front of the lifecycle
pair is not in this list — it is a one-time toggle, on in this repo right now,
its hook firing on every message. Correct usage, not a dead skill.
conductor's only routes — all lateral or downstream
reachable only by typing its name.
superpowers wins the same contest by injecting a routing instruction at session
start: "you MUST use this before any creative work". It routes itself. Sherpa waits.
DESIGN RUNG — genuinely missing, and the one conductor reached outside for.
Not sherpa (staging), not interrogate (viability), not capturerequirements (MVP reqs).
None of the four dead skills is a design step. Routing would not have filled this.
ROUTING BET — that the dead four come alive once reachable.
Untested, and it is the fork: if you would skip them anyway, wiring routes just
adds gates between you and the build. Rip instead. — PENDING APPROVAL
ENFORCEMENT — no bet. 0 CI workflows, 0 pre-commit hooks, every repo.
Every gate in this system is a model choosing to comply. Nothing can refuse.
The only item that changes what is possible rather than what is likely.
5. trim disappears — once its causes do
trim is janitorial work generated by two other problems. Fix the second and it has
no job left. Rip after that, not before.
6. The functions we need — inputs, outputs, and how we would know
named for what they must do, not for the skill that happens to do it. working functions merged; gaps kept separate.
a complaint from someone using it
why this exists + what it must do,
high level, enough to inform design
fatal risks cleared, or the idea
how often it is actually read
MVP / v1 / v1.2 — what is in,
design; rework from a wrong shape
the spec and the diff — nothing
what is missing, what does not
model, not a choice to comply
session re-derive? tree clean at boundary
which rung to enter at, and
sessions started at the wrong rung;
the repo, the session, the prose
text that does not read as generated
drift found per run; vault readable
by someone with no prior context
doc count trend; age of the
"Route to the altitude" is the keystone: nothing performs it, and it is what would
decide whether the three unused ones are ever reached at all.
